name: rudder
description: Maintain a device-local spec from coding-session intent, then generate focused unit tests with your existing coding agent.

interface.longDescription: Rudder turns captured coding-session intent into an approved device-local spec before guiding your existing coding agent through a fresh-slate unit-test workflow. Repository specs remain read-only import sources. Rudder generates focused tests from the local spec and asks concrete follow-up questions to expand it until the configured coverage target is met.
defaultPrompt: Resolve the device-local spec, then generate and verify unit tests for this branch's production changes.
